briefing: Markets were flat to slightly positive today (NASDAQ +0.4%, S&P500 +0.0%), a neutral session with no strong risk-on signal. With cash above the $500 threshold and 3 open slots, I deployed modestly into NU and BTU, two of the least-overbought high-scoring momentum names, while holding all existing positions untouched.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, using indicators like RSI and MACD to confirm the trend is healthy rather than exhausted. Today's picks were chosen partly because their RSI readings (mid-50s to low-60s) showed bullish strength without being overbought, unlike many candidates already flashing RSI above 70.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動量投資是指買入已經處於上升趨勢的股票，並利用RSI（相對強弱指數）和MACD（指數平滑異同移動平均線）等指標確認趨勢仍然健康、尚未過熱。今日選股部分基於RSI讀數處於50多至60出頭區間，顯示上升動力強勁但未達超買水平，相比之下許多候選股RSI已超過70，屬於超買狀態。

market_education.summary_en: Today's session was largely directionless, with the S&P 500 essentially flat and the NASDAQ edging up just 0.4%, suggesting investors are in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to any major catalyst. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off trigger, trading stayed range-bound and low-conviction. This kind of quiet consolidation often precedes a more decisive move once new economic data or earnings news arrives.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢反覆，標普500指數近乎持平，納斯達克指數僅微升0.4%，反映投資者在缺乏明確消息刺激下採取觀望態度。由於沒有明顯的風險偏好或避險訊號，市場交投於區間內整固，方向性不強。這種平靜的整固格局，往往是醞釀下一輪較明確走勢（視乎後續經濟數據或業績表現）的前奏。

trades.reasoning: RSI 56.6 is the least overbought of the top-scored names with a fresh MACD crossover and price above SMA-20, offering room to run on a low-cost entry.
Clean bullish setup (RSI 61.2, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20) diversifies away from tech-heavy holdings on an otherwise quiet day.
